title: AICP Verifiable Credential
description: W3C Verifiable Credential used within the AICP protocol for identity attestation, delegation, and trust.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. First entry must be the W3C Verifiable Credentials context.

issuer.description: DID of the entity that issued this credential.

issuanceDate.description: Date and time when this credential was issued.

expirationDate.description: Date and time when this credential expires.

credentialSubject.description: Claims about the subject of the credential.

type.description: The cryptographic suite used to generate this proof.

created.description: Timestamp when this proof was created.

verificationMethod.description: URI of the verification method (public key) used to generate this proof.

proofValue.description: The digital signature value, encoded in multibase.

challenge.description: A challenge value used to prevent replay attacks.

domain.description: The domain scope for this proof.

id.description: URI identifying this credential's revocation status entry.

revocationListIndex.description: The index of this credential in the revocation bitstring.

revocationListCredential.description: URI of the revocation list credential that contains this entry.

CredentialStatus.description: Revocation status information for this credential.
